name: connected to the stand-in, Web search on
js: t.ask = async (q) => { t.$('#input').value = q; t.$('#composer').requestSubmit(); await t.until(() => !t.$('#stopBtn').hidden, 5000); await t.until(() => t.$('#stopBtn').hidden, 60000); await t.sleep(600); const s = t.state(); return s.chat[s.chat.length - 1]; }; t.log = async () => (await (await fetch('/api/log')).json()); t.chats = async () => (await t.log()).filter(r => r.path === '/api/chat' && !r.format); return [t.$('#status .status-text').textContent, t.$('#webSearchToggle').hidden, t.$('#webSearch').checked]

name: use the model that calls tools
js: const s = t.$('#modelSelect'); s.value = 'mock-researcher'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await t.sleep(300); return t.state().settings.model

name: the model searches, reads a page, then answers citing it
js: const m = await t.ask('How do Bloom filters avoid false negatives?'); return [m.content, m.thinking, m.error ?? null, m.research.map(s => [s.tool, s.input, s.links.map(l => l.url), s.pending ?? null, s.error ?? null])]
expect:
Let me check.

A Bloom filter has no false negatives ([Bloom filter - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bloom_filter)).

name: the reply shows its research folded, with links
js: const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('.msg.assistant')].pop(); const r = el.querySelector('.research'); return [r.open, r.querySelector('summary').textContent, [...r.querySelectorAll('a')].map(a => a.textContent), [...r.querySelectorAll(':scope > ul > li')].map(li => li.firstChild.textContent), el.querySelector('.msg-body > p a').href]

name: what the model was sent: tools, a bigger context, the prompt, focused results
js: const c = (await t.chats()).slice(-3); const tool = (r) => r.turn.filter(m => m.role === 'tool'); const found = tool(c[1])[0].content; const wiki = found.split('## [Probabilistic')[0]; return [c.map(r => [r.model, r.tools, r.num_ctx]), c[0].system.includes('Today is ') && c[0].system.includes('call web_search first'), tool(c[1]).map(m => m.tool_name), wiki.startsWith('## [Bloom filter - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bloom_filter)\nBloom filter\nA Bloom filter is'), wiki.includes('False negatives are impossible'), wiki.includes('gardening'), found.endsWith('[title](address).)'), tool(c[2]).map(m => m.tool_name), c[2].turn.map(m => m.role), (await t.log()).filter(r => r.path.includes('/web_')).map(r => r.query || r.url)]

name: notes extracted with the chat's context, so Ollama doesn't reload the model
js: await t.until(() => t.$('#extractStatus').textContent === '' && document.querySelectorAll('.node').length > 1, 20000); const x = (await t.log()).filter(r => r.format).pop(); return [x.model, x.num_ctx]

name: the hourly limit stops searching, and the model still answers
js: const m = await t.ask('limit please'); const c = (await t.chats()).slice(-2); return [m.content, m.research.map(s => [s.input, s.error]), c.map(r => r.tools), c[1].turn.filter(x => x.role === 'tool')[0].content.includes("Web search isn't available")]
expect:
Let me check.

I couldn't search the web, so from memory: no false negatives.
you have reached your web search hourly request limit, upgrade for higher limits: https://ollama.com/upgrade

name: a model that keeps searching has to answer after 4 rounds
js: const m = await t.ask('loop forever'); const c = (await t.chats()).slice(-5); return [m.content, m.research.map(s => s.input), c.map(r => r.tools), c[4].turn.filter(x => x.role === 'tool').pop().content.endsWith('That was your last search: answer now, from the results above.')]

name: Stop during a search
js: t.$('#input').value = 'slow please'; t.$('#composer').requestSubmit(); await t.until(() => document.querySelector('.msg.assistant:last-child .research .cursor'), 10000); const searching = document.querySelector('.msg.assistant:last-child .research summary').textContent; t.$('#stopBtn').click(); await t.until(() => t.$('#stopBtn').hidden, 5000); await t.sleep(600); const s = t.state(); const m = s.chat[s.chat.length - 1]; const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('.msg.assistant')].pop(); return [searching, m.streaming, m.content, m.error ?? null, m.research.map(x => [x.input, x.error, x.pending ?? null]), !!el.querySelector('.cursor')]

name: with Web search off: no tools, no prompt, the model's own context
js: t.$('#autoNotes').click(); t.$('#webSearch').click(); await t.sleep(300); const m = await t.ask('plain question'); const c = (await t.chats()).pop(); return [t.state().settings.webSearch, c.tools, c.num_ctx ?? null, c.system.includes('Today is'), m.content, m.research ?? null, [...document.querySelectorAll('.msg.assistant')].pop().querySelector('.research')]

name: a model without tools: a toast, and no search
js: t.$('#webSearch').click(); const s = t.$('#modelSelect'); s.value = 'mock-plain'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await t.sleep(300); const m = await t.ask('plain again'); const c = (await t.chats()).pop(); return [t.toast(), c.tools, c.num_ctx, m.content]
expect: mock-plain can't use tools, so it answers without searching the web. Models such as qwen3 can.

name: after a reload the research is still there, folded
js: const s = t.state(); const m = s.chat.find(x => x.research && x.research.length === 2); const el = document.querySelector(`.msg[data-id="${m.id}"] .research`); return [el.open, el.querySelector('summary').textContent, s.chat.flatMap(x => x.research || []).some(x => x.pending)]

name: cloud models hide the toggle
js: t.$('#settingsBtn').click(); const p = t.$('#setProvider'); p.value = 'other'; p.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); t.$('#setApiBase').value = '127.0.0.1:9/v1'; t.$('#settingsDialog').close(); await t.sleep(300); const hidden = t.$('#webSearchToggle').hidden; t.$('#settingsBtn').click(); p.value = 'ollama'; p.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); t.$('#settingsDialog').close(); await t.sleep(300); return [hidden, t.$('#webSearchToggle').hidden]
